title: Body mass index and dyslipidemia influence responses to anti-PD-1 immunotherapy in colorectal cancer.
snippet: Obesity is one of the primary risk factors for colorectal cancer (CRC) development, but  the impact of obesity on therapeutic responses to anti-programmed cell death protein 1 (PD-1) immunotherapy in CRC remains unclear.
